description: Adds a flag to a user (delta 1) or takes one back (-1, not below 0): a silent mark for you; it never bans or warns. An added flag fires the `flag` webhook with by: "developer". Returns the flag count. To ban: neblla_set_ban_status.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

reason.description: Why; goes to the moderation log and the webhook.

name: neblla_flag_user
title: Flag a user
